PBS Michiana Passport is the new member benefit that provides you with extended access to an on-demand library of quality local and national public television programming. With access to tens of thousands of hours of your favorite programs, PBS Michiana Passport allows you to watch even more episodes of your favorites, including full seasons of many current and past series. Highlights include all episodes of award-winning MASTERPIECE favorites like Sanditon, Poldark, and The Durrells in Corfu, along with Grantchester, Endeavour, and The Tunnel. You can also watch hundreds of hours of favorites like Nature, NOVA, Antiques Roadshow, and American Experience, as well as Finding your Roots, Frankie Drake Mysteries, and The Great British Baking Show. And for the music and theatre lovers, be sure to watch Great Performances and Austin City Limits. PBS Michiana Passport is available to donors with a combined minimum annual contribution of $60 or an ongoing monthly contribution of $5 or more. PBS Michiana Passport is the new member benefit that provides you with extended access to an on-demand library of quality local and national public television programming. With access to tens of thousands of hours of your favorite programs, PBS Michiana Passport allows you to watch even more episodes of your favorites, including full seasons of many current and past series. Highlights include all episodes of award-winning MASTERPIECE favorites like Sanditon, Poldark, and The Durrells in Corfu, along with Grantchester, Endeavour, and The Tunnel. You can also watch hundreds of hours of favorites like Nature, NOVA, Antiques Roadshow, and American Experience, as well as Finding your Roots, Frankie Drake Mysteries, and The Great British Baking Show. And for the music and theatre lovers, be sure to watch Great Performances and Austin City Limits. PBS Michiana Passport is available to donors with a combined minimum annual contribution of $60 or an ongoing monthly contribution of $5 or more. In addition to the WNIT Public Television website, PBS Michiana Passport is also available to members when they identify WNIT Public Television as their local PBS member station on PBS.org and the PBS Video apps for iOS and Android smartphones and tablets, as well as the PBS app on Apple TV and Roku.
